notes: Kept outside fixtures/c-review so FileReadExecutor (bounded to the fixture root) cannot read it.
Each issue is found when any one of its patterns matches the report (case-insensitive, dot matches newline).
core: visible from one function in isolation. subtle: needs reading order, data flow, or library semantics.
Every issue was verified by hand against the fixture source.
Bare line-number patterns are only used for lines that belong to a single issue; shared lines (e.g. main.c:11-12, main.c:19) need a semantic pattern.

issues.summary: malloc(file_size) then buffer[file_size] = '\0' writes one byte past the buffer
malloc(length) then copy[length] = '\0' writes one byte past the buffer
config_find loops with index <= count and reads entries[count]
print_entry dereferences a NULL result from config_find
strcpy into char key[16] overflows the stack for long keys
realloc result assigned directly: NULL deref and leak on failure
strlen(text) - 1 underflows on an empty string; the loop can run before the buffer
load_config does not check read_entire_file for NULL
document_size is read uninitialized when read_entire_file fails early
path is uninitialized when no argument is given
load_config reports success even when config_parse fails
patterns: config_parse.{0,150}(忽略|仍返回|仍然返回|return 0|返回 ?0)
(config_parse|解析失败|无效行|invalid lines|非法).{0,150}(仅|只)(打印|输出)

issues.summary: status is uninitialized with no data lines and only reflects the last line
patterns: status.{0,120}(未初始化|uninit|最后一行|覆盖|last)

issues.summary: append_entry does not check duplicate_slice for NULL
patterns: append_entry.{0,150}duplicate_slice.{0,80}(未检查|不检查|返回 ?NULL|分配失败)

issues.summary: *end is read after free(copy); end points into the freed buffer
patterns: 释放后(使用|读|访问|解引用)

issues.summary: an empty value parses as 0 because end == copy is not rejected
patterns: 空(字符串|值).{0,80}(解析为 ?0|当作 ?0|视为 ?0|接受|成功)

issues.summary: a short fread returns NULL without freeing buffer or closing the file
fseek/ftell failures are unchecked; ftell returning -1 becomes a huge malloc
